title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End’s Most Tragic Ship Gets a New Look Ahead of Season 3
content: The exciting Season 2 of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End reached its conclusion in March this year after teasing the manga’s best arc yet. The series continues the journey of Frieren and her party as they continue their travels to the North after Fern became a First Class Mage.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen’s Culling Game Gets a New Look Ahead of Season 4
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 is all set for a major update this month during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary. The third season of the anime follows the aftermath of the Shibuya Incident Arc before commencing the intense Culling Game. As the longest arc of the series, it will be adapted into two anime seasons.

title: 'Super no Ura de Yani Suu Futari' Reveals Additional Staff, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Jinushi 's Super no Ura de Yani Suu Futari ( Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You ) manga revealed addition staff and a second promotional video on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Cyborg 009: Nemesis' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website of the Cyborg 009: Nemesis anime series revealed additional cast and a new character visual (pictured right) on Friday. The anime adapting Shoutarou Ishinomori 's action sci-fi manga will begin streaming in Summer 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Dark Manga Series Ends As Anime Future Remains a Mystery
content: In recent years, anime fans have witnessed several different new releases in the pages of Weekly Shonen Jump come to an end. Unfortunately, Shueisha isn’t the only company that has to release final chapters for some of their biggest manga.

title: Hunter x Hunter Nen x Impact Game Adds DLC Character Zeno on June 18
content: Arc System Works streamed a new character video on Thursday for Bushiroad and Eighting's Hunter x Hunter Nen x Impact 2D 3v3 fighting game based on Yoshihiro Togashi 's Hunter x Hunter manga, and it announces that the DLC character Zeno will launch on June 18 as the fourth and final character of Season Pass 1.
